summary: Reassign unused SaaS seats + onboard new identity vendor for engineering org
description:
Issue summary:
Maya requests reallocation of 25 unused seats from inactive project teams to cover a new contractor cohort, and concurrent onboarding of a new identity provider (OneLogin) for SSO across engineering apps. This includes procurement approval, license transfer or cancellation where possible, and updating SSO connections in the central Okta/OneLogin proxy.

Impact:
- Short term: 15 contractors cannot access paid tools this month (CI runners, internal analytics).
- Financial: potential savings if we cancel underused seats; however we must avoid double-spend on overlapping IdP integrations.
- Security/Compliance: IdP change requires security review and SCIM provisioning configuration to ensure least-privilege provisioning.

Environment:
- Internal apps: CI (Jenkins/Buildkite), Analytics (Metabase), Internal Dashboard (Next.js).
- Affected tenant: redwood-engineering@redwood.ai org.

Steps to reproduce / action items (requested):
1) Inventory current seat assignments and license expiry dates for target vendors (Atlassian Confluence/Jira, Metabase, Sentry).
2) Identify 25 reusable seats (inactive users >90 days) and request license reallocation from vendor portal or finance.
3) Open procurement change request for OneLogin onboarding, attach security questionnaire answers and expected monthly spend.
4) Run security intake (Security team) and if approved, schedule SCIM and SAML setup with IdP and test with staging group.
5) Update onboarding docs and notify IT asset owners when seats reallocated.

Logs / Evidence:
- Last seat usage export: s3://redwood-internal/saas-inventory/2026-03-08/seat-usage.csv
- Contractor start dates: HR doc link (restricted)

Requested budget owner approval: Finance owner - Priya Patel.
Preferred timeline: seats available by 2026-03-20 to match contractor onboarding dates.

1) Finalize seat transfer for 25 users and confirm with vendors. 2) Complete OneLogin onboarding: security signoff, DPA signed, SCIM setup, and smoke tests with staging. 3) Update asset registry and close ticket.
If vendor declines seat transfer, fallback to buying 25 short-term seats via procurement and reconcile after contract negotiation.
